Response call from Good To Go Supermarket regarding two angry female customers in the store; assistance requested to move them along.

Arrived at the response call. The two females claimed they were being racially profiled; the owner stated they had been in the store for more than 25 minutes without buying anything. They argued, but Guard Two de-escalated the situation by giving them reasonable grounds for having to leave the store, and they complied and left.
Lunch break completed; handover to the Afternoon Shift.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 2 x Radio, 1 x Bodycam, 1 x Swipe Key.
Commencing patrols down lower Queen Street.
Response call from Formery security requesting assistance moving along vagrants outside People's Barista.
Arrived at Albert Street; Formery security contacted us to stand down — the individuals had complied when asked to leave. Patrolling down to lower Albert Street.
Arrived at corner of Albert Street and Wyndham Street; welfare check on stores within the area, all clear.

Arrived at the bottom of Wyndham Street / corner of Queen Street; welfare check on stores within the area, all clear. Standing by for nearby response calls and on the lookout for any problematic issues.
Leaving standby; no issues occurred and no response calls received.
Arrived outside Louis Vuitton; noticed Council dealing with a vagrant — standing by in case our assistance is needed.
No issues occurred while on standby.
Arrived at TK Square; welfare check on stores within the area, all clear. Standing by for security presence and on the lookout for any problematic issues.
Leaving standby; walking through Galway Street.
Gore Street check-in, all clear. Commencing a full sweep of Fort Street, Wilson Carpark and Jean Batten Street, with welfare checks on stores along Commerce Street.
Full sweep complete, no issues; welfare checks on stores all clear. Standing by for any problematic issues in the area.
While on standby, response call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a male throwing food at the counter, appearing to be intoxicated; assistance requested to remove him from the store.

Arrived at McDonald's Queen Street; the manager identified the POI. Police — also contacted by the manager — had arrived and were dealing with the situation. Standing by in case assistance was needed.
Police departed the area along with the POI. Standing by for nearby response calls and any problematic issues.
Leaving standby; no issues occurred and no nearby response calls received.

Chancery Square / Freyberg Square check-in, all clear. Heading back to HQ for floor checks and a short break.

Staff member of City Chiropractic successfully and safely escorted out; standing by.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Call from Jo & Joe regarding an intoxicated patron who needed to be moved along.
Arrived on site; Police also in attendance — standing by to assist.

The POI in the photo had been assaulted by three females in the lobby; the duty manager called Police after calling us. The duty manager advised the fight was over drugs and that he will send photos of the three females later tonight. Standing by at Jo & Joe.
Welfare check at Auckland Harbour Suites, all clear; ASG guard Tristan confirmed all good.
Fort Lane, Wilson Carpark on Gore Street and Customs Street checked, all clear.
Welfare check at McDonald's Britomart, all clear; full sweep around Commercial Bay completed with no issues.
Albert Street Mart and Albert Street checked, all clear.
Call from 77 Convenience Store on Victoria Street regarding a vagrant repeatedly entering the store and requesting cash out. Attended the store, but the individual had already left.
Call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a vagrant sleeping inside the store. Attended and requested the individual to leave; he complied and departed.
Full sweep of Aotea Square completed, all clear.
Welfare check at Ace Karaoke completed, all clear.
Pioneer Women's Memorial Hall and Chancery Square checked, all clear.
Call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a vagrant sleeping inside the store; responding.

Arrived and removed the sleeping individual. Staff advised another individual was inside the restroom; the female was escorted out. A customer offered her coffee and she remained seated inside the store under observation.
The female individual departed McDonald's Queen Street; officers remained at the location, available for further calls.
Returned to Headquarters for a break while remaining available for calls.
Officers remained at Headquarters, available for calls.
Shift handover to the morning team completed; no major issues reported.
